name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with enough detail to act on
title: ""
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

One or two sentences: the symptom, what it affects, and how bad it is. Lead
with the observable behavior, not the suspected cause.

## Impact

- Who or what is affected:
- Severity: blocks a core flow / degrades it / cosmetic
- Data or trust at stake: is anything lost, sent, charged, or shown to the wrong
  person? Write "none" when nothing is.

## What happened

The exact behavior, in order. Quote the user-facing text, the panel state, the
tool result, or the silence as it appeared. If Aether did the right thing but
said the wrong thing (or said nothing), say so plainly.

## What was expected

What should have happened instead, and why that is the correct behavior.

## Suspected cause (optional)

Where in the code, config or data it looks wrong, and how other places were
ruled out. A guess is fine; say it is a guess.

## Workaround (optional)

What was done to keep going, if anything.

## Fix acceptance (optional)

How a fix will be recognized — the behavior to restore and the test that should
pin it.
